page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highcpu-32 is a compute-optimized server instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor. This x86_64 architecture is built on 16 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The system is equipped with 60.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.88 GB of RAM per core. It does not include bundled local NVMe storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the top 10% of tested systems. Multi-core performance is also strong, with Geekbench multi-core and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression reaching top-tier and top 25% thresholds respectively. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 vector and neural network instructions, which assist in cryptographic tasks and image processing. Memory bandwidth and database operations perform in the average tier.

Given its high compute-to-memory ratio and lack of local storage, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk caching. It is optimized for tasks such as software compilation, text and image processing, static web serving, and small-scale language model inference.
